title: Why Doesn't Dotty Duckling Get Wet?

scenes.title: Why Doesn't Dotty Duckling Get Wet?
scenes.subtitle: An Animal Fact Story  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Why Doesn't Dotty Duckling Get Wet?
Pitter, patter, pitter, patter.
It was a soft, rainy morning. Pitter, patter, went the rain.
Mama, it's raining! Can we go outside and splash?
Yes, little one! But first, what do we wear in the rain? Can you guess?
A raincoat and rain boots! You look ready, Honey.
My coat is yellow, and my boots are red!
Let's hold hands, stay together, and splash in the little puddles.
Down by the pond, they saw Dotty Duckling, paddling happily in the rain.
Quack, quack! Good morning, Honey! I love rainy days!
Dotty, you don't have a raincoat! Aren't you all wet?
Look at my feathers. Are they wet, or dry? What do you think?
They are dry! The raindrops roll right off me!
Wow! But how? Why don't you get wet, Dotty?
Here is my duck secret. Near my tail, I have a tiny spot that makes a special oil.
I rub the oil on my feathers with my beak, like this. Rub, rub, rub!
Special oil? That's so clever!
The oil keeps the water out. So the rain can't soak in. My feathers are waterproof!
See the raindrops on my back? They sit like shiny little beads. Let's count them as they roll off. Ready?
One. Two. Three!
Roll, roll, roll! Off they go!
Splash!
Splash! Here came Pip Puppy, hopping through the puddles.
Hello, friends! Oh, my fur is all drippy!
Pip's fur gets wet, but Dotty's feathers stay dry. Everybody is made in a special way!
Do you know what puppies do when we're wet? Can you guess?
We shake! Shake, shake, shake!
Shake with me! Wiggle your head, wiggle your arms. Shake, shake, shake!
Hee hee! Little drops everywhere!
Mama Bunny wrapped Pip in a soft, warm towel. Next time, Pip will wear his raincoat too.
Now let's jump in the puddles! Stomp your feet with us!
Splish, splash, puddle jump! Stomp, stomp, stomp!
Splash!
Splish, splash, puddle jump! Hop, hop, hop!
Splash!
Splish, splash, one more jump! Quack, quack, quack!
Splash!
What does a duck say? Can you say it, too?
Quack, quack! What a great quack!
Dotty, how do you swim so fast?
Look at my feet! They are wide and flat, like little paddles.
Ducks have webbed feet. There is soft skin between their toes, so they can push the water. Paddle, paddle!
Can you make your hands into duck feet? Paddle, paddle, paddle!
Paddle, paddle! Look, I'm a duck! Quack!
Then the rain went slow, and slower, and stopped. The sun came out to say hello.
Look! A rainbow! What colors can you see?
Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple!
Rain is good for the flowers, good for the pond, and good for little ducks like me!
Let's take a big breath of fresh, rainy-day air. Breathe in, slowly.
And breathe out. Ahhh.
Today I learned a duck secret! Dotty's feathers have special oil, so the rain rolls right off.
And you have a raincoat, Honey! We both stay cosy.
And I have a big shake! Woof!
Everybody is made in a special way. Thank you for splashing with us! See you next time on Honey Bunny Kidz.
